title: T1000-E: Battery/charger
description: Model and validate battery/charger on T1000-E. Currently not modeled in DTS. Add battery0/pmic0 aliases if hardware supports telemetry.
close_reason: Added battery voltage sensing to T1000-E DTS: ADC channel 0 (P0.02/AIN0) configured with 12-bit resolution, voltage-divider node with 1:2 ratio matching Meshtastic ADC_MULTIPLIER, and battery0 alias. No PMIC present on this hardware (simple voltage divider only).
